H1_structural.note: both ports are the same constant exact-ZOH double integrator; only the dimension differs (2 vs 3).

H1_equivalence.note: open-loop residual-acceleration command over 2000 random states/disturbances: the normalized (decision=residual accel) and conventional force-input (decision=CoM force, matched weights R_f=R/m^2) centroidal MPCs are the same map. Closed-loop trajectory diffs are chaos-confounded near the balance limit and are not used.

H1_config_invariance.note: task apparent inertia Lambda_t computed over a 36-point right-arm kinematic sweep; it varies substantially while (A_t,B_t) stay exactly constant: all configuration dependence is confined to recovery.

H1_angular_channel.note: body-port angular-momentum channel e_dot_h = u_theta + d_theta is a first-order integrator; its discrete (A_theta,B_theta)=(I, T*I) equals the exact-ZOH first-order integrator exactly and is configuration-independent, while the centroidal rotational inertia I_G that the moment recovery must invert varies over the same 36-point arm sweep -- the momentum-channel analogue of the Lambda_t result.

H2_representation.note: faithful recovery (e_ddot=u+d) with G1 mass / contact-consistent Lambda_t; sustained [12.0, 0.0, 0.0] N pelvis and [0.0, 8.0, 0.0] N hand force; SS over (3.0, 4.0) s.

H2_full_realizer.status: Offset-free on the standing G1: the realizer drives CoM linear acceleration to c_ddot_d+u_c (centroidal-wrench recovery) and the hand acceleration to x_ddot_d+u_t, so e_ddot=u+d is faithfully realized and the observer removes the steady-state offset for both ports without falling. Dynamic-gait (contact-switching) recovery is future work.
H2_full_realizer.note: decoupled: body port under [12.0, 0.0, 0.0] N pelvis force; task port under [0.0, 8.0, 0.0] N hand force; from t=1.0s, SS over (3.0, 4.0) s.
